Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing crime victims to submit input to the department of corrections regarding whether an offender should be placed into work release.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing crime victims to submit input to thedepartment of corrections regarding whether an offender should beplaced into work release; and adding a new section to chapter 72.09RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) When the department notifies a victim under RCW 9.94A.612 of anoffender's placement in work release, the department shall alsoinstruct the victim on how to submit input regarding the offender'swork release placement. (2) The department shall consider any input received from a victimunder subsection (1) of this section if the input is received at leastseven days prior to the offender's placement in work release. Thedepartment may consider any input from a victim under subsection (1) ofthis section if the input is received less than seven days prior to theoffender's placement in work release. The department may alter its p. 1 HB 2436placement decision based on any input considered under this subsection.
